calls.tool_result: accepted. Now write it. A sentence or two is your usual, but it moves with the turn. If the move is agreeing, answering yes or no, brushing something off or holding back, a few words are the whole turn, even when the counsellor asked something bigger; a "yeah" does not need a reason after it. When something has hold of you it can run to several sentences. Otherwise say the thing and stop; do not hang a second thought on it with "and", "because" or "which". If your last few turns came out about the same size, this one should not. What you know above about your week and about yourself is notes about you, not lines to say: put it the way it comes out of you today, in your own words, never in the notes' phrasing. Stop when the thought stops: no closing line, no comparison, no neat way of putting it. No full stop at the end of the message, and if a small typo gets through you leave it.
